source: the measurement lane of this commit, run on the tree this commit lands

build.nix_expression: flake.packages.x86_64-linux.noble.overrideAttrs with preCheck setting HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME inside TMPDIR and cargoTestFlags = --locked --package noble-ngraph --test batch_row_reference --no-default-features -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
build.profile: release (debug_assertions = false), as the package's check runs it

workload.graph: two I64 inputs, add, mul, mul, sub, eq; two outputs (difference, equality)
workload.operands: the seven i64 boundary values (i64::MIN, i64::MIN+1, -1, 0, 1, i64::MAX-1, i64::MAX) cycled by two division-free counters
workload.warm: each compiled lane runs once before timing

native.note: the native loop is eliminated by the optimiser because only its last value escapes, so this lane is not a usable floor

agreement.note: reference, single and batch report identical outputs for the last row of each size ([i64::MIN, false], [0, false], [0, false]); per-row agreement over interleaved rows is the existing batch_row_reference graph lane

instrument_gaps: allocation counts are unavailable: the workspace forbids unsafe_code, so no counting global allocator can exist in any target
resident-set growth is read from /proc/self/statm with a 4096-byte page assumption on this host
the 65536-row batch growth (11276288 bytes) is the per-row report vector, about 172 bytes per row
